Service port grpc 50051->50051 matches, image already present on machine, and GetErrorLogs found no application errors, ruling out code/dependency faults. Alerts show no metric anomalies; exit 137 comes from the kubelet SIGKILL after probe failure (terminationGracePeriodSeconds 5), Reason is Error not OOMKilled.
